One sticker only, no props, no hands, no people, no cast background, no words, no letters, no numerals, no icons, no arrows, no watermarks. Leave the entire central 65 percent area completely blank and light so accessible dark-green Chinese type and a functional arrow icon can be overlaid later in real HTML. The sticker should nearly fill the image, about 85% of width, with at least 5% transparent margin all around. Very short soft contact shadow only. Refined, nostalgic and touching, like something a parent keeps in a child's memory box; not glossy plastic, not corporate UI, not a loud cartoon. Crisp transparent cutout edges and subtle paper fibers. Shape: round scalloped kindergarten teacher's reward sticker, 12 softly rounded petals, muted warm butter yellow petals with a warm ivory round center. A very fine uneven sienna-brown printed outline sits just inside the petal edge, faint crayon-like print variation. Blank ivory center takes up 65 percent diameter. A tiny flat coral-red crayon heart is printed ON ONE petal near the upper right edge, NOT floating outside, as the only decorative detail. The silhouette must unmistakably feel like a traditional 'good job' flower sticker children bring home proudly, elegant and simple at 96px. Square asset. No face or eyes.
